about: Declared differences (APP-DESIGN §7.3): each mask names the element that may differ, the screens it applies to, the rectangle it covers in tC4's screenshot of each, and the ruling it cites (`build`, or an owner ruling that docs/PLAN.md lists under "Where the rebuild differs from tC4 4.0 on purpose"). `target` is tC4's element; `rust` is the rebuild's when it differs, null meaning the same as `target`; `<OBS>` and `<BIBLE>` stand for the two projects. `meaning` lists the values of what the DOM shows that may differ, as [tC4, rebuild] pairs. Rectangles are measured on tC4 by measure-masks.mjs on the baseline's machine; the gate fails a capture whose masked element lies outside its rectangle.

masks.why: The line names the program that runs: tC4 4.0.0-rc.1 (d310bf3) there, the rebuild's own version and build here.
The attachment names the program and the platform that send the report: tC4's build and Linux x86_64 there, the rebuild's own here.
The rebuild syncs OBS projects, so the shared OBS card reads "Sync with Door43" where tC4 reads "Upload changes".

The rebuild opens private repositories after sign-in, so its note has no sentence that only public repositories can be opened; a new key replaces openDoor43.where. tC4's note has no test id: the unit that captures these screens sets `rust` to the rebuild's element.

tC4's refusal says to make sure that the repository is public; the rebuild opens private repositories, so its sentence must not say this (the new text is not decided yet). The unit that captures the screen sets `rust` to the rebuild's element.

target.text: tC4 could not get the project from Door43.
